source.title: Canary Wharf building events (per-event citations in notes)

_method: Building-level vacancy and refurbishment events for the peer-comps district, harvested and cross-checked 2026-08-29. Building names match data/seed_cw_buildings_2026.json exactly where the building is on the roster, because the comps join is an exact name match. Each note names its own citations, the roster-file compromise applied to events. Known gaps, kept as gaps: the Tower Hamlets planning reference for 8 Canada Square is not in open press; HSBC's exact expiry month is unpublished ('2027'); whether Citi's 2026 completion has occurred is unconfirmed.

events.note: HSBC announced June 2023 it will not renew; the lease expires in 2027. KPF retrofit plans submitted to Tower Hamlets in August 2026: offices levels 2-33, a 181-room hotel above, public rooftop, ~70-75% of structure and facade retained; trade-press cost estimate GBP 800m-1bn, unconfirmed by the developer. Sources: Construction Enquirer 2026-08-13; East London Times 2026-08-12; ianvisits 2024-07-18.

Full-building refurbishment of Citi's EMEA HQ, on site since July 2023 (WilkinsonEyre / Overbury; 9,900 m2 of new facade), completion expected 2026 -- roughly GBP 1bn per Fortune 2025-01-16, against the tower's GBP 1.2bn purchase in 2019. Sources: Fortune via Yahoo Finance 2025-01-16; WilkinsonEyre and Permasteelisa project pages.
Under offer on ~350,000 sq ft per Colliers, London Offices Snapshot July 2026 (published 2026-07-29). Not on the estate roster; named as published.
